Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0051267: CP2 mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity
and replace by parent GO:0051377 mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31641


Annotations are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kIaLy6L377lih24RxmEwzJ-hTAnj2LSloz748jhqPE4/edit?gid=0#gid=0

- 3 ComplexPortal 
- 1 MGI
- 2 SGD

There are no mappings to this term. This term is not present in any subset.
